Class Card

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Building, Character, Event
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract base for all game cards (characters, events, buildings).

Subclasses must implement:

  • canBeDrawn(Player) – whether this card can be taken by the given player.
  • insert(Map) – adds itself to the correct bucket of a card-type map (used both for player hands and for event dispatch in EventsState).
  • activeEffect(Set, Trigger) – applies the card's game effect.
  • getTypeLabel() and getEffectsLabel() – provide display strings for the CardDTO sent to clients.

  • Method Details

    • canBeDrawn

      public abstract boolean canBeDrawn(Player p)
      Returns true if this card can be taken by p. Pass null to test unconditional drawability (e.g. event cards always return false; buildings check food against cost).
      Parameters:
      p - the player attempting to draw, or null
      Returns:
      true if the card is available to that player

    • insert

      public abstract void insert(Map<CardType, Set<Card>> cards)
      Adds this card to the appropriate bucket in cards. Used to populate a player's hand and to sort visible board cards into typed buckets for event dispatch.
      Parameters:
      cards - the card-type map to insert into

    • activeEffect

      public abstract void activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
      Applies this card's game effect to the given set of players when the specified trigger fires.
      Parameters:
      players - the players affected (typically a singleton for character cards, the full player set for events)
      t - the trigger that caused the effect to activate
